releases.notes:
## Bug Fixes
- do not throw when the interaction manager is unavailable while retrying ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/d9d5ff40a7ec3e9ad72c20bf6bc827fdc3b5225a))
- pass the matching position to the solid-block check ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/17c1bfe32a4c1c4569aaf0146672d7232c50d1e5))

## Performance Improvements
- drop a block-placement check that the structure filter already made ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/c9ac576204d2e6baff85b88c1e91bdd232a7bb6b))

## Builds
- wire applyPatches.gradle into the build ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/6ae1f066d3fbf84f81aad59e0b7b12f0cccb96c5))
- apply AI patches to a copy of src/, leaving the tree clean ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/bfedfd8327ef80deae492de882a6b0d6050c2d31))

## Chores
- add Gradle task to auto-apply AI-generated patches ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/4492d299f81ce7a319f8b4ea4f30e01219294f81))
- add search-path optimization patch ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/7742a5556bec26a4c70c92d4cad32716a7bace81))
- add .gitignore for Gradle/Loom/IDEA artifacts ([z7087](https://github.com/z7087/blockminer/commit/7d8c0f9c06a8264c37d3b0d0c98db6172107517d))

## Commits
- f1f8a6c: no pullrequest build and prerelease. (z7087)
